name: Tool-protocol reliability: read serialization
status_note: One design run three times. Run 1 and the final run are valid; the confirmation run is INVALID (inference server stopped accepting connections partway through the treatment arm), archived, and excluded from every conclusion.

runs.label: run1
runs.validity_note: No validity gates were registered for this run; a later check found 0 inference-server errors in 3,440 model calls.
runs.completed_utc_note: approximate, minute precision (from the run log and the last recorded model call)
runs.orchestration: arms sequential, CONTROL first, inference server restarted between arms

runs.label: confirmation
runs.validity_note: Registered checks (48 paired tasks, 48 traces per arm, identical host versions) passed but did not cover server health. About 2,623 s into the TREATMENT arm the inference server stopped accepting connections and never recovered; the last 12 TREATMENT tasks failed with connection errors. Ruled INVALID / COMPROMISED; the label printed by the frozen analysis is void.
runs.completed_utc_note: approximate, minute precision (from the run log and the last recorded model call)
runs.orchestration: arms sequential, CONTROL first, inference server restarted between arms

runs.label: final
runs.validity_note: All six registered checks V1-V6 passed: 96/96 jobs ended normally, arm-order rule held, 670 health checks with 0 failed attempts, 0 HTTP 5xx responses.
runs.orchestration: one inference server for both arms; arm order alternating by task; 2 jobs at a time; health checks and abort on any server failure
